description: Export the cue cards of a variant in the fixed DelegAIze design (same template as the local kit from get_presentation_kit). format 'html' (default) builds a single OFFLINE mobile page stored as a document — open it with get_document_link, works in airplane mode. Per card: slide image (toggle 'Bild aus/an'), bullets or 'Volltext' (full speaker text), Regie hint, big countdown (red when over), total vs. plan with +/- drift, progress bar, 'Als Nächstes', swipe + arrow keys, wake lock, remembers the last card; the Zurück/Start/Weiter buttons always stay visible (only the text area scrolls). Slide image per card, first match wins: slide_images[slide_id or 1-based talk number] → slide content.page_image_url → slide image_url; sources may be data:image/png|jpeg|gif|webp;base64, an http(s) URL or a storage path of this tenant; images are embedded (max 4 MB each). Without an image the card works without one. images:'none' skips images. format 'video' is not available on the server — use get_presentation_kit (bauen.py builds the voice-over video locally). Required: presentation_id and variant_id or language. Returns { document_id, cards, images_embedded, image_warnings }.

format.description: Output format; 'html' (default) builds an offline mobile page

images.description: auto (default): embed slide images where available; none: cards without images

slide_images.description: Override per card: key = slide_id or 1-based talk number, value = data:image/...;base64 URI, http(s) URL or own storage path (e.g. rendered page PNGs)

name: export_cue_cards
